acceptance: No Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock or src/. flake.nix no longer imports crane or rust-overlay, no longer defines crateSrc or a crane build, and `nix flake check` (or the repo's build command) still passes. The devshell keeps just, shellcheck, zmx, the jail packages and the agents/quotient inputs; rust toolchain removal is fine if nothing else needs it.
body: Nothing in the design needs Rust. Keep the flake's jail and devshell scaffolding, which the rest of this repo's workflow depends on; remove only the crate and the builders that existed to build it.
title: Delete the Rust crate and its packaging
